parole.testo: It is uncertain whether the noun fluture came before it or was derived from it. Probably ultimately of imitative origin, through a hypothetical *fâltura. Or linked to Albanian and possibly derived from it; compare flutur. Cognate with Aromanian flitur, fliturari. Other theories suggest a Vulgar Lati

Probably a substratum word, akin to or derived from Albanian mugull. Also, possibly from a Vulgar Latin root *muculus, diminutive of Latin mūcus, or simply reformed as a singular from mucuri as the plural of muc.
